Flusssteuerung. Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00064" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00064">[SWS_CanTp_00064]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00079" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00079">[SWS_CanTp_00079]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00084" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00084">[SWS_CanTp_00084]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00269" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00269">[SWS_CanTp_00269]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00312" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00312">[SWS_CanTp_00312]</a>.</p> <h4>Adressierungsformate, Metadaten und CAN-FD-Besonderheiten</h4> <p><code>CanTp</code> unterstützt neben der Standardadressierung (Normal Addressing) auch Extended, Mixed 11-Bit, Normal Fixed und Mixed 29-Bit Adressierung <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00330" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00330">[SWS_CanTp_00330]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00331" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00331">[SWS_CanTp_00331]</a>. Bei Extended Addressing wird die Zieladresse <code>N_TA</code> im ersten Datenbyte der CAN-Nachricht übermittelt; bei Mixed Addressing enthält das erste Datenbyte die Adresserweiterung <code>N_AE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00095" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00095">[SWS_CanTp_00095]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00283" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00283">[SWS_CanTp_00283]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00284" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00284">[SWS_CanTp_00284]</a>. Bei generischen Verbindungen (Generic Connections) werden diese Adressinformationen dynamisch über Metadaten übergeben und zwischengespeichert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00330" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00330">[SWS_CanTp_00330]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00334" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00334">[SWS_CanTp_00334]</a>. Trifft während eines laufenden Empfangs auf einem Kanal mit Metadaten ein neuer SF oder FF ein, wird dieser ignoriert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00337" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00337">[SWS_CanTp_00337]</a>. Bei Verbindungen ohne Metadaten führt das Eintreffen eines SF/FF mit identischer Quell- und Zieladressierung (gleiche <code>N_AI</code>) zum Abbruch der bisherigen Sitzung und Neustart des Empfangs, während abweichende Adressierungen ignoriert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00124" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00124">[SWS_CanTp_00124]</a>.</p> <p>Funktionale Adressierung (1:n-Kommunikation) ist nach der Spezifikation ausschließlich für unsegmentierte Single Frames zulässig <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00092" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00092">[SWS_CanTp_00092]</a>. Wird versucht, eine funktionale Verbindung über mehrere Segmente abzuwickeln, weist <code>CanTp</code> die Anforderung ab und meldet den Laufzeitfehler <code>CANTP_E_INVALID_TATYPE</code> an das DET <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00093" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00093">[SWS_CanTp_00093]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00352" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00352">[SWS_CanTp_00352]</a>.</p> <p>Für Netzwerke mit Auffüllung (Padding) oder CAN FD gelten strenge Längenvorgaben: Ist für eine Verbindung das Padding aktiviert (<code>CanTpRxPaddingActivation</code> bzw. <code>CanTpTxPaddingActivation</code> auf <code>CANTP_ON</code>), müssen alle SF-, FC- und letzten CF-Nachrichten mit einer Nutzlast bis 8 Byte exakt auf 8 Byte mit dem konfigurierten Füllbyte <code>CANTP_PADDING_BYTE</code> aufgefüllt werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00059" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00059">[SWS_CanTp_00059]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00344" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00344">[SWS_CanTp_00344]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00347" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00347">[SWS_CanTp_00347]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00348" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00348">[SWS_CanTp_00348]</a>. Unabhängig vom Padding überträgt <code>CanTp</code> stets nur die tatsächlichen Nutzdatenbytes an die oberen Schichten <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00116" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00116">[SWS_CanTp_00116]</a>. Bei CAN FD werden Datenlängen auf die nächsthöhere gültige diskrete DLC-Stufe (0..8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64) aufgerundet und ungenutzte Bytes ebenfalls mit <code>CANTP_PADDING_BYTE</code> initialisiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00350" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00350">[SWS_CanTp_00350]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00351" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00351">[SWS_CanTp_00351]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00354" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00354">[SWS_CanTp_00354]</a>.</p> <h4>Verhalten im Fehlerfall und Abbruchbedingungen</h4> <p>Fehler werden in <code>CanTp</code> nach Entwicklungsfehlern (Development Errors) und Laufzeitfehlern (Runtime Errors) differenziert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00293" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00293">[SWS_CanTp_00293]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00352" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00352">[SWS_CanTp_00352]</a>. Treten Entwicklungsfehler auf – etwa die Übergabe von ungültigen Zeigern (<code>CANTP_E_PARAM_POINTER</code>) oder fehlerhaften Kanal-IDs (<code>CANTP_E_PARAM_ID</code>) –, bricht die jeweilige API-Funktion sofort ohne Zustandsänderung ab, gibt <code>E_NOT_OK</code> zurück und meldet das Ereignis via <code>Det_ReportError</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00217" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00217">[SWS_CanTp_00217]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00254" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00254">[SWS_CanTp_00254]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00260" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00260">[SWS_CanTp_00260]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00294" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00294">[SWS_CanTp_00294]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00319" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00319">[SWS_CanTp_00319]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00321" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00321">[SWS_CanTp_00321]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00322" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00322">[SWS_CanTp_00322]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00324" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00324">[SWS_CanTp_00324]</a>. Unerwartete CAN-Rahmen werden gemäß einer internen Zustandstabelle verarbeitet oder verworfen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00057" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00057">[SWS_CanTp_00057]</a>.</p> <p>Eine laufende Sitzung wird in folgenden Situationen abgebrochen: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Timeout-Verletzungen:</strong> Ablauf von <code>N_As</code> oder <code>N_Bs</code> auf Senderseite führt zum Abbruch und Benachrichtigung über <code>PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation(E_NOT_OK)</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00075" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00075">[SWS_CanTp_00075]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00205" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00205">[SWS_CanTp_00205]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00310" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00310">[SWS_CanTp_00310]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00316" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00316">[SWS_CanTp_00316]</a>. Ablauf von <code>N_Ar</code> oder <code>N_Cr</code> auf Empfängerseite bricht die Sitzung über <code>PduR_CanTpRxIndication(E_NOT_OK)</code> ab <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00311" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00311">[SWS_CanTp_00311]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00313" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00313">[SWS_CanTp_00313]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Puffer- und Statusfehler:</strong> Meldet <code>PduR_CanTpStartOfReception</code> den Fehler <code>BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK</code>, wird der Empfang ohne Flow Control und ohne <code>RxIndication</code> abgebrochen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00081" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00081">[SWS_CanTp_00081]</a>. Meldet die Funktion <code>BUFREQ_E_OVFL</code>, sendet <code>CanTp</code> bei FF ein <code>FC(OVFLW)</code> und bricht ab <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00318" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00318">[SWS_CanTp_00318]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00353" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00353">[SWS_CanTp_00353]</a>. Empfängt ein Sender ein FC mit Status <code>OVFLW</code> oder ungültigem Statusbyte, wird der Sendevorgang sofort beendet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00309" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00309">[SWS_CanTp_00309]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00317" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00317">[SWS_CanTp_00317]</a>. Gibt <code>PduR_CanTpCopyRxData</code> bei einem CF <code>BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK</code> zurück, bricht der Empfang mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code> ab <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00271" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00271">[SWS_CanTp_00271]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Treiberfehler:</strong> Schlägt <code>CanIf_Transmit</code> fehl oder bestätigt die Treiberschicht eine gesendete Nachricht mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code>, wird die betreffende Sitzung unverzüglich terminiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00342" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00342">[SWS_CanTp_00342]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00343" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00343">[SWS_CanTp_00343]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00355" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00355">[SWS_CanTp_00355]</a>.</li> <li><strong>Padding-Verletzungen:</strong> Unterschreitet ein empfangener SF, FC oder letzter CF bei aktiviertem Padding die Länge von 8 Byte, wird die Sitzung abgebrochen und der Laufzeitfehler <code>CANTP_E_PADDING</code> an das DET gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00345" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00345">[SWS_CanTp_00345]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00346" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00346">[SWS_CanTp_00346]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00349" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00349">[SWS_CanTp_00349]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00352" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00352">[SWS_CanTp_00352]</a>.</li> </ul> <p>Laufende Übertragungen und Empfangsvorgänge können zudem explizit durch die oberen Schichten storniert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00242" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00242">[SWS_CanTp_00242]</a>. Ein Sendeabbruch via <code>CanTp_CancelTransmit</code> beendet die Transportsitzung und quittiert dies gegenüber <code>PduR</code> mit <code>PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation(E_NOT_OK)</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00243" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00243">[SWS_CanTp_00243]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00246" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00246">[SWS_CanTp_00246]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00255" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00255">[SWS_CanTp_00255]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00256" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00256">[SWS_CanTp_00256]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00274" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00274">[SWS_CanTp_00274]</a>. Beim Empfangsabbruch via <code>CanTp_CancelReceive</code> prüft <code>CanTp</code> jedoch strenge Randbedingungen: Handelt es sich um einen Single Frame oder läuft bereits die Überwachung des letzten Consecutive Frame eines Blocks (Timer <code>N_Cr</code> aktiv), wird die Stornierung mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code> abgewiesen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00257" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00257">[SWS_CanTp_00257]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00261" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00261">[SWS_CanTp_00261]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00262" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00262">[SWS_CanTp_00262]</a>. Wird der Empfang erfolgreich storniert, ruft <code>CanTp</code> die Funktion <code>PduR_CanTpRxIndication</code> mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code> auf <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00263" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00263">[SWS_CanTp_00263]</a>. Wird eine Stornierung für eine nicht aktive Sitzung angefordert, meldet <code>CanTp</code> den Laufzeitfehler <code>CANTP_E_OPER_NOT_SUPPORTED</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00254" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00254">[SWS_CanTp_00254]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00260" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00260">[SWS_CanTp_00260]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_CanTp_00352" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_CanTp_00352">[SWS_CanTp_00352]</a>.</p> <div class="diagram" id="diag-cancel-rx"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" The CanTp module shall have two internal states, CANTP_OFF and CANTP_ON .

Unbewertet

Konstituierend · requirement

The function CanTp_Init shall initialize all global variables of the module and sets all transport protocol connections in a sub - state of CANTP_ON , in which n either segmented transmission nor segmented reception are in progress (Rx thre ad in state CANTP_RX_WAIT and Tx thread in state CANTP_TX_WAIT ).

Unbewertet

If development error detection for the CanTp module is enabled the CanTp mo dule shall raise an error ( CANTP_E_UNINIT ) when the PDU Router or CAN Interfac e tries to use any function (except CanTp_GetVersionInfo) before the function CanTp_Init has been called.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00031

Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00033])
Konstituierend · requirement

If a recommendation of ISO 15765 - 2 is not explicitly excluded in the SWS, the CanTp m odule shall follow this recommendation.

Unbewertet

A CAN NSduId shall only be linked to one CAN LSduId that is used to transmit SF, FF, FC and CF frames.

Konstituierend · requirement

Furthermore, it should be noted that when receiving a FF N - PDU, the Flow Control shall only be sent a fter having the result of the PduR_CanTpStartOfReception() service.

Unbewertet

Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp shall use the same value for the BS and STmin parameters on each FC sent during a segmented reception. Different values of these parameters can be used on different N - SDUs reception.

When the transmit confirmation is not received after a maximum time (equal to N_As), the CanTp module shall abort the corr esponding session. The N - PDU re mains unavailable to other concurrent sessions until the TxConfirmation is received, successful or not.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00075
▸ SWS_CanTp_00076 [SWS_CanTp_00076] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet

Konstituierend · requirement

For confirmation calls, the CanTp module shall provide the function CanTp_TxConfirmation() .

▸ SWS_CanTp_00078 [SWS_CanTp_00078] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00078])
Konstituierend · requirement

For reception indication, the CanTp module shall provide CanTp_RxIndicatio n() .

Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00079])
Konstituierend · requirement

When receiving an SF or an FF N - PDU, the CanTp module shall notify the upper layer (PDU Router) about this reception using the PduR_CanTpStartOfReception function.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00079
▸ SWS_CanTp_00080 [SWS_CanTp_00080] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00080])
Konstituierend · requirement

The available Rx buffer size is reported to the Can Tp in the output pointer parameter of the PduR_CanTpStartOfReception() service. The available Rx buffer can be smaller than the expected N - SDU data length.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00080
▸ SWS_CanTp_00081 [SWS_CanTp_00081] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00081])
Konstituierend · requirement

After the reception of a First Frame or Single Frame, if the function PduR_CanTpStartOfReception() returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK to the CanTp module, the CanTp module shall abort the reception of this N - SDU. No Flow Control will be sent and PduR_CanTpRxIndicatio n() will not be called in this case.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00081
▸ SWS_CanTp_00082 [SWS_CanTp_00082] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00082])
Konstituierend · requirement

After the reception of a First Frame, if the function PduR_CanTpStartOfReception() returns BUFREQ_OK with a smaller available buffer size than needed for the nex t block, the CanTp module shall start the timer N_Br.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00082
▸ SWS_CanTp_00084 [SWS_CanTp_00084] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00084])
Konstituierend · requirement

When the transport reception session is completed (successfully or not) the CanTp module shall call the upper layer notification service PduR_CanTpRxIndication() .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00084
▸ SWS_CanTp_00086 [SWS_CanTp_00086] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00086])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall call the PduR_CanTpCopyTxData service for each segment that is sent (SF, FF and CF). The upper layer copy the transmit data on the PduInfoType structure.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00086
▸ SWS_CanTp_00087 [SWS_CanTp_00087] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00087])
Konstituierend · requirement

If PduR_CanTpCopyTxData() returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK , the CanTp module shall abort the transmit request and notify the upper layer of this failure by calling the callback fu nction PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation() with the result E_NOT_OK.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00087
▸ SWS_CanTp_00089 [SWS_CanTp_00089] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00089])
Konstituierend · requirement

When Tx data is available, the CanTp module shall resume the transmission of the N - SDU.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00089
▸ SWS_CanTp_00090 [SWS_CanTp_00090] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00090])
Konstituierend · requirement

When the transport transmission session is successfully completed, the CanTp module shall call a notification service of the upper layer, PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation() , with the result E_OK.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00090
▸ SWS_CanTp_00091 [SWS_CanTp_00091] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00091])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall support optional primitives (proposed in ISO 15765 - 2 specification) for the dynamic setting of some transport protoc ol internal parameters (STmin and BS) by application. The BS value is only a maximum value. For reasons of buffer length, the CAN Transport Layer can adapt the BS value within the limit of the configured maximum value.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00091
▸ SWS_CanTp_00092 [SWS_CanTp_00092] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00092])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall provide 1 to n communication (i.e. functional addressing [14] ), in the form of functionality to SF N - PDUs (and only SF N - SDU).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00092
▸ SWS_CanTp_00093 [SWS_CanTp_00093] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00093])
Konstituierend · requirement

If a multiple segmented session occurs (on both receiver and sender side) with a handle whose communication type is functional, the CanTp module shall reject the request and r eport the runtime error code CANTP_E_INVALID_TATYPE to the Default Error Tracer .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00093
▸ SWS_CanTp_00094 [SWS_CanTp_00094] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00094])
Konstituierend · requirement

Thus the CAN LSduId of a FC frame combined with its N_TA value (e.g. the N_AI) or with N_AE value shall only identify one CAN NSduId.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00094
▸ SWS_CanTp_00095 [SWS_CanTp_00095] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00095])
Konstituierend · requirement

Therefore, in extended addressing N - PDU reception, the CanTp module shall extract the N_TA value to establish the related N - SDU. The same process s hall be applied for mixed addressing mode in relation with N_AE value.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00095
▸ SWS_CanTp_00096 [SWS_CanTp_00096] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00096])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall support several connections simultaneously.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00096
▸ SWS_CanTp_00111 [SWS_CanTp_00111] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00111])
Konstituierend · requirement

If called when the CanTp module is in the global state CANTP_ON, the function CanTp_Init shall return the module to state Idle (state = CANTP_ON, but neither transmission nor reception are in progress).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00111
▸ SWS_CanTp_00116 [SWS_CanTp_00116] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00116])
Konstituierend · requirement

In both padding and no padding modes, the CanTp module shall only transfer used data bytes to the upper layer.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00116
▸ SWS_CanTp_00121 [SWS_CanTp_00121] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00121])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each N - SDU is statically linked to one connection channel. This connection channel represents an internal path, for the transmission or receiving of the N - SDU. A connection channel is attached to one or more N - SDU.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00121
▸ SWS_CanTp_00122 [SWS_CanTp_00122] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00122])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each connection channel is independent of the other connection channels. This means that a connection channel uses its own resources, such as internal buffer, timer, or state machine.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00122
▸ SWS_CanTp_00123 [SWS_CanTp_00123] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00123])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the configured transmit connection channel is in use (state CANTP_TX_PROCESSING ), the CanTp mo dule shall reject new transmission requests linked to this channel. To reject a transmission, CanTp returns E_NOT_OK when the upper layer asks for a transmission with the CanTp_Transmit() function.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00123
▸ SWS_CanTp_00124 [SWS_CanTp_00124] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00124])
Konstituierend · requirement

When an SF or FF N - PD U without MetaData is received, and the corresponding connection channel is currently receiving the same connection (state CANTP_RX_PROCESSING , same N_AI), the CanTp module shall abort the reception in progress and shall process the received frame as the s tart of a new reception. When an SF or FF N - PDU without MetaData is received for another connection (different N_AI) on an active connection channel, the SF or FF shall be ignored.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00124
▸ SWS_CanTp_00146 [SWS_CanTp_00146] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00146])
Konstituierend · requirement

The listed configurat ion items can be derived from a network description database, which is based on the EcuConfigurationTemplate. The configuration tool should extract all information to configure the CAN Transport Protocol.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00146
▸ SWS_CanTp_00147 [SWS_CanTp_00147] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00147])
Konstituierend · requirement

The consisten cy of the configuration must be checked by the configuration tool at configuration time.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00147
▸ SWS_CanTp_00161 [SWS_CanTp_00161] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00161])
Konstituierend · requirement

A static status variable, denoting whether a BSW module is in itialized, should be initialized with value 0 before any APIs of the BSW module are called. The initialization function of the BSW modules will set the static status variable to a value not equal to 0. This variable is used to check if the module has been initialized before calling an API.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00161
▸ SWS_CanTp_00164 [SWS_CanTp_00164] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00164])
Konstituierend · requirement

The main function for scheduling the CAN TP (Entry point for scheduling) The main function will be called by the Schedule Manager or by th e Free Running Timer module according of the call period needed. CanTp_MainFunction is involved in handling of CAN TP timeouts N_As, N_Bs, N_Cs, N_Ar, N_Br, N_Cr and STMmin.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00164
▸ SWS_CanTp_00166 [SWS_CanTp_00166] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00166])
Konstituierend · requirement

At the reception of a FF or last CF of a block, the CanTp module shall start a time - out N_Br before calling PduR_CanTpStartOfReception or PduR_CanTpCopyRxData .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00166
▸ SWS_CanTp_00167 [SWS_CanTp_00167] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00167])
Konstituierend · requirement

After a transmission request from upper layer, the CanTp module shall start time - out N_Cs before the call of PduR_CanTpCopyTxData . If no data is ava ilable before the timer elapsed, the CanTp module shall abort the communication.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00167
▸ SWS_CanTp_00168 [SWS_CanTp_00168] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00168])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall be in the CANTP_OFF state after power up.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00168
▸ SWS_CanTp_00169 [SWS_CanTp_00169] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00169])
Konstituierend · requirement

In the state CANTP_OFF, the CanTp shall allow an update of the p ostbuild configuration.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00169
▸ SWS_CanTp_00170 [SWS_CanTp_00170] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00170])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall chang e to the internal state CANTP_ON when the CanTp has been successfully initialized with CanTp_Init() .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00170
▸ SWS_CanTp_00176 [SWS_CanTp_00176] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00176])
Konstituierend · requirement

The function CanTp_Transmit() shall be asynchronous.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00176
▸ SWS_CanTp_00177 [SWS_CanTp_00177] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00177])
Konstituierend · requirement

After the transmit request was accepted, the CanTp module shall notify its upper layer if the N - SDU transfer is fully processed (successfully or not).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00177
▸ SWS_CanTp_00184 [SWS_CanTp_00184] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00184])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the PduR_CanTpCopyTxData() function returns BU FREQ_E_BUSY, the CanTp module shall later (implementation specific) retry to copy the data.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00184
▸ SWS_CanTp_00190 [SWS_CanTp_00190] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00190])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module shall route the N - SDU through the correctly configured connection channel.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00190
▸ SWS_CanTp_00199 [SWS_CanTp_00199] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00199])
Konstituierend · requirement

The CanTp module’s environment shall call CanTp_Init befo re using the CanTp module for further processing.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00199
▸ SWS_CanTp_00200 [SWS_CanTp_00200] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00200])
Konstituierend · requirement

The function CanTp_Shutdown shall not raise a notification about the pending frame transmission or reception.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00200
▸ SWS_CanTp_00202 [SWS_CanTp_00202] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00202])
Konstituierend · requirement

The function CanTp_Shutdown shall close all pending transport protocol connections, free all resources and set t he CanTp module into the CANTP_OFF state.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_CanTp_00202
▸ SWS_CanTp_00204 [SWS_CanTp_00204] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00204])

The CanTp module shall notify the upper layer by calling the PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation callback when the transmit request has been completed.

▸ SWS_CanTp_00205 [SWS_CanTp_00205] requirement CANTP
Unbewertet

The CanTp module shall abort the transmit request and call the PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation callback function with the appropriate error result value if an error occurred (over flow, N_As timeout, N_Bs timeout and so on).

Unbewertet
CANTP ([SWS_CanTp_00345])
Konstituierend · requirement

If frames with a payload <= 8 (either CAN 2.0 frames or small CAN FD frames) are used for a Rx N - SDU and CanTpRxPaddi ngActivation is equal to CANTP_ON , then CanTp receives by means of CanTp_RxIndication() call an SF Rx N - PDU belonging to that N - SDU, with a length smaller than eight bytes (i.e. PduInfoPtr.SduLength < 8), CanTp shall reject the reception . T he runtime error code CANTP_E_PADDING shall be reported to the Default Error Tracer .

SduLength != 8), CanTp shall abort the ongoing reception by calling PduR_CanTpRxIndication() with the result E_NOT_OK . T he runtime error code CANTP_E_PADDING shall be reported to the Default Error Tracer .

Unused bytes in N - PDU shall be updated with CANTP_PADDING_BYTE (see ECUC_CanTp_00298 ) .
